name: Tanger Outlets Fort Worth
summary: Tanger Outlets Fort Worth is a popular outlet shopping destination featuring over 75 brand-name and designer stores offering significant discounts on quality merchandise. Located conveniently on North Freeway in Fort Worth, this open-air center attracts bargain hunters from across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex with its diverse mix of fashion, athletic, and specialty retailers.
demographics: Tanger Outlets Fort Worth attracts a diverse mix of bargain-conscious shoppers, including middle-income families with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $100,000 annually. The primary trade area draws from the northern Fort Worth suburbs and extends into southern Denton County, appealing to value-seeking millennials and Gen X shoppers aged 25-54 who prioritize brand names at discounted prices. The center sees significant weekend traffic from families making it a destination shopping experience, with visitors willing to drive 30-45 minutes for the outlet shopping experience and deal-hunting opportunities across multiple brand-name retailers.
description: Tanger Outlets Fort Worth stands as a premier outlet shopping destination in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, strategically located at 15853 North Freeway in Fort Worth, Texas. As part of the renowned Tanger Outlets chain, this open-air shopping center offers an impressive collection of over 75 brand-name and designer outlet stores, providing shoppers with significant savings on quality merchandise. The center features a diverse tenant mix including popular fashion retailers, athletic brands, home goods stores, and specialty shops, all offering outlet pricing that attracts deal-seekers from across the region. With convenient hours operating from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM Monday through Saturday and 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM on Sundays, the center accommodates busy schedules while maintaining extended hours during peak shopping seasons like Black Friday and the holiday season. The outlet center has earned a strong reputation with a 4.5-star rating from over 6,000 reviews, reflecting its commitment to providing an exceptional shopping experience with ample parking, well-maintained facilities, and a comfortable outdoor shopping environment that showcases the best of outlet retail in the Fort Worth area.
